response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/systems engineer with broad language experience (DLang, C/C++, JS/TS, Java) and some low-level and embedded exposure, but he lacks the two hard gating requirements for this role: native-level Japanese proficiency and demonstrated Linux kernel source-code modification experience. His career has been overwhelmingly focused on web, mobile, and application-layer development rather than embedded/networking security, with no evidence of MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, or L2/L3 networking work.
strengths: Deep, varied engineering background spanning 15+ years across web, mobile, and systems programming
Solid C/C++ experience from National Instruments and audio/embedded side projects
Demonstrated ability to learn new domains quickly and contribute across the stack
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, which is a hard requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience
No background in networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips) or L2/L3 networking
